title: Bound nonlinear weak-reference error without an exponential amplification factor
statement: Let u be ANY admitted nonlinear energy solution under b+e with ||u(t)||2<=M, and a a smooth LINEAR viscous reference under b on the unit torus. For E=||u-a||2², divergence-free skew transport and integration by parts give (1/2)Eprime+nu||grad(u-a)||2²<=integral a_i (u_j-e_j) partial_j(u-a)_i. Since ||e||2<=1, this is at most ||a||infinity(M+1)||grad(u-a)||2. Young absorption yields Eprime<=||a||infinity²(M+1)²/nu. No Gronwall coefficient multiplying E, exponential reference-derivative cost, uniqueness or strong continuity is needed. Use the one-sided energy trace to reset at fixed stage boundaries. This bound is for a LINEAR reference and the exact skew EXTRA-ADVECTION equation; it is not a statement for ordinary forced-background perturbations.
